provenance.asset_description: Two illustrations overlayed over a blurred background. On the left is The Functionary, a human woman with bright red skin and long white hair pulled into a ponytail smiles confidently at the viewer; she wears weather-worn armor, a bandana around her neck, and an intricate half-mask that covers the entire top half of her face and rises into a crown. On the right is Lord Gulv Tevineg, a light skinned, grey haired man standing smugly, wearing his crimson doublet and using a cane to support himself.
